messages.subject: define margins in box ?  (shiny Dashboard)
parts:
Hi everybody,

I want to put some text at the top of a box in a shiny dashboard and it seems complicated as I want that this text only appears after an actionButton (I need to put it in serve) and as it has to be bigger (ex : h3/h2)

1) I tried with a renderUI:

             output$textRealign2 <- renderUI({
               box(background = "black", width = 4, height = 150,
                   h3("Mean"),
                   h4("yeah")
               ) # box                                                              
             })

but unfortunately, the text is too low in the box (see below)



I would like something more than below



2) I try to put it in the title of the box but same result, too low

             output$textRealign2 <- renderUI({
               box(background = "black", width = 4, height = 150,
                   title = h3("Mean"),
                   h4("yeah")
               ) # box                                                              
             })

Does anyone have any ideas to write with h3 just under the box frame ??
Can we define the widths of margins ?
Or specify that the box has no longer title ?

Thank you for your idea !!

Cha
